report_name: Meta Disrupts Iran-Linked AI-Powered Influence Operation

threat_actors.name: Iran-linked Influence Operation Group
threat_actors.description: A state-aligned influence campaign originating from Iran that used AI-generated content and fake personas on Facebook and Instagram to sow political division in the U.S. by pushing anti-Republican and anti-Israel messaging.
threat_actors.goals: To sow political division within the U.S. and amplify anti-Republican and anti-Israel narratives by impersonating legitimate American voices.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
attack_patterns.description: The actors researched U.S. political discourse to identify high-profile individuals, such as politicians and journalists, to target for engagement.

attack_patterns.name: Establish Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The operation created a network of 23 Facebook and 11 Instagram accounts, using detailed fake profiles of U.S.-based activists, students, and graphic designers.

attack_patterns.name: Generate Deepfakes
attack_patterns.description: Used Artificial Intelligence (AI) to generate some of the political content and create sophisticated fake personas for the influence campaign.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing via Service
attack_patterns.description: The operators sent direct messages to journalists and politicians via Facebook and Instagram in an attempt to get them to collaborate on and amplify the campaign's narratives.

attack_patterns.name: External Proxy
attack_patterns.description: Routed network activity through proxy services located in the U.S. and Canada to conceal their origin in Iran.

attack_patterns.name: Impersonation
attack_patterns.description: The operation created fake personas impersonating U.S. activists, students, and graphic designers to lend credibility to their politically divisive content.

campaigns.name: Iran-linked AI Influence Campaign (Aug 2026)
campaigns.description: An influence operation active in August 2026 that used a network of 23 Facebook and 11 Instagram accounts with AI-generated content and personas to target U.S. audiences with politically divisive content. The campaign was disrupted by Meta.

identities.name: U.S. Politicians
identities.description: A class of individuals targeted by the Iran-linked influence operation through direct messaging in an attempt to amplify the campaign's content.

identities.name: Journalists
identities.description: A class of individuals targeted by the Iran-linked influence operation through direct messaging in an attempt to amplify the campaign's content.

infrastructure.name: North American Proxy Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Proxy services located in the U.S. and Canada were used to route traffic and conceal the operation's Iranian origin.
